about: Small hand-written test set for Exercise 4 (airline customer messages). Used to reject near-duplicate training texts and for an optional evaluation after retraining.

airline.question: Which team should handle this message?

choices.baggage: lost, delayed or damaged bags, baggage allowance and fees
choices.booking changes: changing dates, flights, names or seats on an existing booking
choices.loyalty: frequent-flyer points, status tiers and member benefits
choices.refunds: money back for cancelled flights, unused tickets or extra charges

cases.text: My suitcase did not arrive in Lisbon and the tracking number shows nothing.
Can I bring skis as a second checked item on my flight to Geneva?
The handle of my bag was broken when I collected it at the belt.
I need to move my return flight from Sunday to Tuesday.
My last name is misspelled on the ticket. Can you correct it?
Is it possible to switch to an aisle seat on the morning flight?
The miles from my trip to Oslo never showed up in my account.
How many flights do I need this year to keep my Gold status?
Can my partner use my lounge access when we travel together?
You cancelled my flight on 3 May and I still have not received my money.
I was charged twice for the same seat upgrade. Please return one payment.
I could not travel because of illness. Can I get my unused ticket refunded?
